visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand holds a light blue ice cream cup featuring white minimalist tree graphics and Japanese branding. Behind the cup, a large colorful Japanese advertisement for "Sugar Butter Tree" ice cream is visible on a supermarket shelf. The environment is brightly lit with overhead commercial lighting. Traditional Chinese subtitles and a channel logo are overlaid at the bottom of the frame. (2) The camera transitions to a top-down view of a supermarket freezer rack filled with rows of the same light blue ice cream cups. A single hand reaches into the frame and picks up one cup. The background shows various other frozen snack packages in white and red. Text overlays continue to provide context about the product's availability. (3) In a closer shot, possibly indoors at a table, the person uses their fingers to peel back the white paper lid of the ice cream container. This action reveals a generous layer of crushed, golden-brown biscuit pieces covering the surface of the dessert. The lighting is soft and warm. A small transparent spoon is held ready near the cup. (4) The person scoops a portion of the white vanilla-colored ice cream using the small transparent plastic spoon, pulling up a mix of ice cream and crunchy biscuit fragments. They hold the spoon close to the camera lens to show the internal texture. Subtitles explain the taste and texture of the snack while the hand remains the central visual focus.
